_note: Fictional Ledgerly demo catalog. Every product here is fixture data with provenance mock. Prices are integer minor units. Covers are drawn in code by ProductCover, keyed on slug; no image files. Sellers come from sellers.json.

products.title: Grain & Gradient
products.subtitle: 40 film-emulation Lightroom presets
description: Forty looks built from scanned negatives, not from sliders. Each preset carries its own grain profile, so the texture scales with your ISO instead of sitting on top like a filter.
Ten warm stocks, ten cool, ten neutral, ten pushed. Made in Austin over two years of client work, and every look has a real photograph behind it.

cover.motif: warm amber to teal gradient with film grain

products.title: Kontur Type Specimen Kit
products.subtitle: 12 display fonts with specimen posters
description: Twelve display faces from the Kontur library, each with a printed specimen poster at A2. The faces share one skeleton and vary in weight, contrast and width, so they mix without fighting.
Every font ships as a variable file plus static instances. The posters are layered PDFs you can reprint with your own text.

cover.motif: giant black letterform on paper white

products.title: Onda Drum Library
products.subtitle: 600 one-shots and loops
description: Six hundred drum sounds recorded in a concrete room in São Paulo and cut to the transient. Kicks, snares, hats, toms and percussion, each in three mic positions.
The loops are tempo-labelled and dry. Nothing is layered or pre-mixed, so the sounds sit where you put them.

cover.motif: concentric waveform rings, ink on cream

products.title: Ledger Layouts for Framer
products.subtitle: 18 SaaS marketing templates
description: Eighteen marketing page templates for Framer, built on one grid and one type scale. Landing, pricing, changelog, docs, careers and the rest of a software site.
Every page uses the same component set, so a change to a button or a card runs through the whole site.

products.title: The Quiet Workbook
products.subtitle: 120-page PDF for freelancers pricing their work
description: A workbook for freelancers who undercharge. It walks from costs to a day rate to a project price, with a worksheet at each step and a worked example from a real studio.
Written after a decade of quoting design work. The maths is simple; the hard part is writing the number down.

cover.motif: single serif title on matte olive

products.title: Lowpoly Botanicals
products.subtitle: 80 game-ready plant models
description: Eighty low-poly plants for games and real-time scenes. Ferns, grasses, shrubs, succulents and six trees, each under 900 triangles with a single shared atlas.
Modelled by hand, not decimated. The silhouettes read at distance and the palette is flat-shaded, so they light cleanly in any engine.

cover.motif: faceted leaf cluster on deep green

products.title: Notion OS for Studios
products.subtitle: Client, invoice and project system
description: One Notion workspace that runs a small studio. Clients, proposals, projects, tasks, invoices and a weekly review, linked so a project always knows its client and its invoice.
Built for teams of two to ten. Duplicate it, rename the studio, and the dashboards fill in as you work.

products.title: Streetlight Sessions
products.subtitle: 10-track ambient EP, WAV + stems
description: Ten ambient pieces recorded at night under one sodium lamp, on tape, with a single synth and a room mic. The hum of the lamp is in every track.
The stems are included so you can score with the parts, not just the mix.
